title: In the Shadows: Vishimtar
summary: Control eggs, corrupted drakes and curses while breaking Vishimtar's final health lock.
overview: Control eggs, corrupted drakes and curses while breaking Vishimtar's final health lock.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Reserve spirit interactions for cursed players.
Assign egg damage and deliberate shadow control before the final curse cycle.

phases.label: Eggs and shadows
phases.description: Control eggs and new shadow spawns while keeping the tank healthy.

phases.label: Doom cycle
phases.description: Use cursed players and mournful spirits to lower the health lock until the boss can die.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Eggs arrive on a repeating timer and hatch into six drakes if left for a minute.
At 76% health, incorporeal shadows begin spawning. Killing one creates a lifedrain shadow and increases that new shadow's melee strength.
At 51%, the fight adds another cloud and activates the corrupted drakes.
At 26%, Vishimtar applies doom curses and becomes locked at 25% health. Cursed players must tell a mournful spirit 'shoulder my burden' to remove their curse and lower the lock by one point.
An uncursed player can consume a spirit without lowering the lock. Two minutes out of combat resets the encounter.

notes: Approval E354. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
